<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        out.append((n['color'], min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols)))
    return out
before = snap(current_frame)
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':5,'col':37}])
print("after click:", snap(current_frame))
res = action(['LEFT'])
print("after LEFT:", snap(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
